caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device composed of several interlocking parts, rendered in shades of brown with visible wood grain and texture. The central element is a vertically oriented rectangular wooden block, which serves as the main body and has two round holes on its front face. Attached at the top of this main block is a horizontal crosspiece secured with bolts. Angled upward from this crosspiece is a cylindrical handle with four small holes along one side. Affixed to the side of the main block is a secondary, jointed wooden lever, connected with a metal pin, which pivots outward at an angle. The entire object is rendered within a rectangular border on a light, beige background.
title: Wagon Jack
